outputs: Contextual captions describing customer preferences and behaviors
Contextual captions that explain possible contexts behind human movement trajectories

changes_made.explanation: Consolidated dataset names to two main variants, normalized Llama2 to Llama-2, removed redundant output description
Normalized all ROUGE variants to base ROUGE metric and BERT Score to BERTScore format
No LLMs were used as judges; they were only used for generation or data synthesis
Paper only mentions human participants for data creation, not for evaluation of generated outputs

overall_notes: The paper clearly addresses NLG tasks (contextual captioning) and uses standard automatic metrics (ROUGE, BERTScore). No LLM-as-judge or human evaluation was conducted. The metadata extraction was generally accurate with minor normalization needed.
